mcp_policy: Disable every locally configured server by explicit per-server override
session_policy: Fresh standalone context per task; no resume/fork, subagents, external review tools, or cross-attempt memory
usage_cost_policy: Record exposed usage and charges; unavailable tokens/costs remain null, not zero
source_basis: Local CLI version/help/features/MCP inspection and saved model preferences; no fresh documentation retrieval or provider validation
